title: 3-Step Biblical Morning Anxiety Reset
hook: Morning dread? Try this 3-step reset before coffee.
script: Morning dread? Try this 3-step reset before coffee. Your body wakes with a cortisol spike, but God gives a way to peace. Step one: Scripture aloud. Whisper, I lay down and slept; I woke again, for the Lord sustained me, Psalm 3:5. Hearing your own voice anchors truth. Step two: Physical grounding. Feet on the floor, hand on heart, breathe in for four, out for six. Pray, Jesus, guard my mind and day. Step three: Single-task focus. Pick one small thing—make the bed, drink water—and do it with God. Repeat daily for seven mornings and watch anxiety lose its grip.

title: Before Coffee: Calm Your Morning in 3 Moves
hook: If you're feeling anxious, watch this before you check your phone.
script: If you're feeling anxious, watch this before you check your phone. In 20 seconds: morning anxiety is normal biology, not failure. Now, reset with truth. Step one, speak Psalm 118:24: This is the day the Lord has made; I will rejoice and be glad in it. Step two, ground your senses. Name five things you see, four you feel, three you hear, two you smell, one you taste, while saying, The Lord is my shepherd. Step three, single-task with purpose. Choose one next right thing and offer it: Lord, I do this with You. Save this and make it your first habit.

title: Breathe, Believe, Begin: A Morning Peace Routine
hook: If God feels silent right now, try this the moment you wake.
script: If God feels silent right now, try this the moment you wake. Step one: speak Scripture out loud. When I am afraid, I put my trust in You, Psalm 56:3. Step two: ground your body while you breathe. Press your feet into the floor, inhale four, hold four, exhale six. Pray with each breath: Abba, I belong to You. Step three: begin small. Ask, Spirit, what’s my one faithful step? Then do just that—shower, journal one line, or sit with your Bible for two minutes. Peace grows with practice. Do this for seven mornings and notice how your heart steadies.
